name: switchtoolbox
description: MiniToolbox — launches React, API backend, and Electron together

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -k -n react,api,electron -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: npx -y wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm --prefix src/MiniToolbox.Electron start
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix src/MiniToolbox.React install && npm --prefix src/MiniToolbox.Api install && npm --prefix src/MiniToolbox.Electron install
